title: Is Your Model Fairly Certain? Uncertainty-Aware Fairness Evaluation for LLMs
benchmark_measurement: Bias detection in religious contexts using the uncertainty-aware fairness metric (UCerF) on the BBQ Lite dataset.
findings: On the BBQ Lite dataset, Mistral 7B demonstrated higher fairness (UCerF score: 0.975) in the context of religion compared to Pythia 1B (UCerF score: 0.902). The paper suggests Pythia 1B is more biased in social aspects like religion compared to Mistral 7B.
